title: Plan routes on the map
summary: A new Plan route tool lets you tap out a journey on any map and see each leg's miles, days and terrain.
items: Tap the map to add waypoints; points near a place snap to it, and on gridded maps they snap to tile centres.
Tap a leg to insert a waypoint, tap a waypoint to remove it, or drag it. Type instead and the keyboard work too.
DMs can set a scale bar on maps without a grid, and Measure uses it.
Ship voyages can be drawn on gridded maps and sent straight into the ship's voyage request, with the typed tiles kept in sync.
